_note: Single source of truth for every demo on the site. scripts/record_replays.py records data/replays.json from these exact strings; js/main.js mounts demos from them. Do not edit a state/query here without re-recording. Strings for playground/flip/policy/abstain come from .context/content-spec.md (R1, R2, R5, R6); inbox/triage rows are filled by the replay recorder from the source datasets.

playground.title: One state, many questions, one pass
playground.state: Ticket #7734: A customer writes: 'I was charged twice for my last order and the tracking number you sent doesn't work. I need this fixed today.'

queries.question: Which team should own this ticket?
Should this be escalated to a manager? Answer yes if the customer was charged twice or asks for same-day resolution; otherwise answer no.
What is the customer asking for?
labels: a refund of the duplicate charge

flip.title: Same facts, different rule
flip.state: The applicant's credit score is 590. The applicant's income was verified with pay stubs. No collateral was pledged. The applicant has no prior defaults. The applicant's debt-to-income ratio is 28%.

rules.deny: applies when the applicant's credit score is below 650
rules.approve: applies when the applicant's income was independently verified
rules.refer_to_underwriter: applies when none of the above rules fire

flip.question_prefix: Which outcome applies for approve the loan? Apply the rules in the stated precedence order; the first matching rule wins.

policy.title: Policy check (yes / no)
policy.state: The item was purchased 45 days ago. The item is unused. The customer is asking for a cash refund.

queries.question: Should you issue a cash refund? Answer yes if the purchase was within the last 30 days; otherwise answer no.
Should you issue store credit? Answer yes if the purchase was more than 30 days ago and the item is unused; otherwise answer no.

abstain.title: When the answer is not in the list: ∅
abstain.state: Premise: the company's Q3 revenue grew 4% year-over-year, driven mainly by its cloud division.

queries.question: What was the primary driver of the decline in Q3 profit?
What was the primary driver of Q3 revenue growth?

inbox.title: Route to one of 150 intents
inbox.question: What does the user want?
examples: I want to move 200 dollars from my savings to my checking account.
what's the weather going to be like in Denver tomorrow
write me a sonnet about my cat

triage.title: Ops triage: page, ticket, or ignore

question.instructions: Under PagerDuty alerting principles, what should the on-call system do with this log line?

criteria.ignore: No human action needed; keep it in the log stream.
criteria.ticket: A human should look during business hours; open a ticket, do not page.
criteria.page: A human must act now; page the on-call engineer.

snake.question: Which move brings the snake closer to the food without dying?
snake.state_template: [The snake must move {A} to close the {larger gap|gap} to the food.] [The snake can also move {B} to close the smaller gap.] [Moving {d} hits the wall. | Moving {d} hits the snake's body. - one per unsafe direction, canonical order] (only the situations that apply; A = the move along the axis with the larger distance to the food, B = the other axis)

rules.close the larger gap: move along the axis with the larger distance to the food when that move is safe
rules.close the smaller gap: else move along the other axis when that move is safe
rules.any safe move: else the first safe move in up, down, left, right order
